integrity.independence: No independent scientific audit has been performed.
integrity.priority_scope: The elementary star polynomial, basic Blaschke theory, and coincident ferromagnetic Poisson-kernel formula are not claimed new.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic phase monotonicity, reciprocal-polynomial symmetry, scalar contraction and arc counting; exact finite algebra and numerical checks are supplementary.

limitations: Only stars, strictly antiferromagnetic nonzero edge interactions, and one uniform field. The uniform asymptotic and limiting law need a common positive lower bound on antiferromagnetic strength. No assertion for general antiferromagnetic trees or mixed-sign interactions; general Blaschke fixed-point results may cover the qualitative count.
scientific_scope: Uniform-field Ising stars with arbitrary strictly antiferromagnetic couplings; exact finite complex zero geometry and quantitative high-degree circular bulk and exceptional roots.
title: Two exceptional Lee–Yang zeros in heterogeneous antiferromagnetic Ising stars
